claim: The check operation in spec_service returns the completeness report exactly as the agent's last save of the stored payload reported it, and the Check route POST /documents/check calls it.

citations.quote:
`spec_service.check` (hub/hub/spec_service.py, ~1494) returns "exactly as the agent's last save
  of the stored payload reported it": `_completeness_report` over the payload.

The Check route
  (`POST /documents/check`, hub/hub/api/v1/spec.py ~3056) calls it.
